WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
), above_overall AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.overall_avg_hgb
    FROM patient_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_avg_hgb
), ranked AS (
    SELECT ID, avg_hgb,
           avg_hgb - overall_avg_hgb AS above_overall_by,
           avg_hgb - AVG(avg_hgb) OVER () AS difference_from_above_group_avg
    FROM above_overall
)
SELECT ID, avg_hgb, above_overall_by, difference_from_above_group_avg
FROM ranked
ORDER BY difference_from_above_group_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average HGB is the average across all non-missing Laboratory HGB records; each patient average uses that patient's non-missing records.
